comment: tintindex per face = Direction#get3DDataValue, so the colour handler can pick the one the state faces. That is why there is one model and no rotation. The sprite is a flat fill and carries nothing but alpha: a block colour handler returns RGB only, so the transparency has to come from here. It is ours rather than white_stained_glass because vanilla's bakes in a border ring (edge alpha 163, interior 102) and every block drawing its own frame rules a wall into a grid.
